test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/285901230dbb488a9bcc8e627f37446afc09e831828d28ec21922075faa4351c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series → Elements shift upward clockwise and the top right corner element is replaced by new element. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff070a5c56609c5b0998029e6b9607e544c2304fa8f25c6b3977126e4fa9d64c.png] 

2) Second box series → Top three element shift clockwise and bottom three elements shift anticlockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43c4dbaf146e18d47c66f2f3d7555d5e99b30c32d142e9fa80c3b59a5777b4e2.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71e7c682a16f8665aed08bc3ae9bfd6c4271a702a4bead6a09283b139d637179.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
